from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import app
from models import complaints

client = TestClient(app)

def test_resolve_complaint():
    # Initial state check
    initial_complaints = [c.id for c in complaints]
    initial_status = complaints[0].status
    
    # Resolve the first complaint
    response = client.post(f"/complaints/{complaints[0].id}/resolve")
    assert response.status_code == 303
    assert response.headers["location"] == "/complaints"
    
    # Verify status change
    assert complaints[0].status == "resolved"
    
    # Verify order is unchanged
    current_complaints = [c.id for c in complaints]
    assert initial_complaints == current_complaints

def test_reopen_complaint():
    # Ensure it's resolved first
    complaint = complaints[0]
    complaint.status = "resolved"
    initial_order = [c.id for c in complaints]
    
    # Reopen
    response = client.post(f"/complaints/{complaint.id}/reopen")
    assert response.status_code == 303
    assert response.headers["location"] == "/complaints"
    
    # Verify status change
    assert complaint.status == "open"
    
    # Verify order is unchanged
    current_order = [c.id for c in complaints]
    assert initial_order == current_order
